narrative.details:
Ugh... It's so hot...

I was exploring this area, when all of a sudden, the heat just became unbearable. I must be suffering from heat exhaustion.

Please, help me get back to my friend Spraggle at Marshal's Refuge. I think I'm well enough to follow you there.

I am feeling a little out of it, so if I do happen to faint again, just splash some water on me from Spraggle's canteen. That should work, I hope...
narrative.objectives:
Lead Ringo to Spraggle Frock at Marshal's Refuge.

If Ringo faints, use Spraggle's Canteen to revive him.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Ringo's not in the best shape, adventurer, but I am glad to have him back in one piece!

Thank you for finding him.
narrative.requestItemsText: I've been so worried about Ringo...
narrative.endText: Escort Ringo to Spraggle Frock at Marshal's Refuge
